name: Horned Devil

traits.name: Devil's Sight
traits.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The devil makes two Fork attacks and one Tail attack.

actions.name: Fork
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Hurl Flame
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 150 ft. Hit: 24 (7d6) Fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it starts burning.

description: Horned devils, or cornugons, are winged shock troops feared even by other devils, wading into battle with barbed forks and a whip-like tail wreathed in flame.
